title: Add opaque keyset-pagination cursors
description:
Groundwork for replacing OFFSET pagination on the activity feed (API-58), which times out past page 200.

`encodeCursor`/`decodeCursor` wrap `(createdAt, id)` in an opaque base64url string and validate it on the way back in; `toPage` turns a `limit + 1` fetch into a page plus next cursor. No endpoint uses it yet.
